about: Files expected in the autosteer data directory (AUTOSTEER_DATA_DIR); see autosteer/data_files.py.

source.how: converted from STEER-generation's pickles to Parquet, with duplicated example seeds, seed candidates and templates removed and the unvetted 'backward_induction copy' templates dropped (October 2026); the load-time template corrections folded into templates/ by scripts/migrations/fold_template_fixes.py (October 2026); templates whose text uses a placeholder their filler never returns removed by scripts/migrations/drop_unfillable_templates.py; the templates/ folders of 15 elements now written in code and of 3 elements without a filler (monotone_sc, sc_axioms, sc_dictatorship) deleted; templates that repeated a text in another setting merged into one text with several settings (variants keep their ids; identical variants kept once, published ones all kept) by scripts/migrations/merge_template_settings.py (October 2026)
